attributes.name: Forgotten Pharaoh
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, encounter it and ignore the Forgotten Pharaoh's power that happens before you act.

Before you act, succeed at a Stealth 13 check or bury a card. Then the Forgotten Pharaoh is evaded; shuffle her into a random open location deck.

If undefeated, suffer the scourge Curse of Daybane.
